summary: Items as authored records with a per-actor inventory the simulation owns; effects are a closed set the world already implements

coordination.notes: Contract: docs/SCENARIO_PACKS.md, now the implemented 'Items' section. Lifted only the `items` reserved-key refusal in ScenarioDefinition::from_document and the matching one in validate.mjs; `resources`, `triggers` and `quests` keep theirs, and scenario-resources lifts `resources` in parallel. Did not touch FactionState.resources as a type, FactionPolicy, storage caps as owned data, from_scenario's economy or island_scene.gd. An item whose effect grants a resource names the key as a plain string and clamps through the existing FactionPolicy.storage_caps read the tick's income already uses; the resources lane's catalogue check adopts the key at integration. The manifest's `items` key is `[]` or a path to the pack's catalogue, embedded like buildings and personas; scenario-resources can mirror the shape for `resources`.

defects_found.summary: content/characters/captain.json and content/characters/betty.json both declare a signatureWeaponId that no record defined, and tools/src/validate.mjs never resolved the field. The same class of silent dangle as the earlier victory.lootTableId defect.
defects_found.detail: weapon.captain.handsome_jack_steam_carbine is now defined by content/scenarios/pirate_island/items.json and validate.mjs proves that a character a scenario starts has its signatureWeaponId defined in that scenario's catalogue. weapon.betty.boarding_mace remains undefined: betty is not started by any scenario, so no pack catalogue can own it yet. Still open, and named here so it is not lost.
